PATTERN: Ned doesn't code through sustained focus. He prompts Claude Code, lets it work, scrolls Reddit/phone/other stuff, comes back when the task is done, reviews, prompts again. Discontinuous cycles, not continuous attention.

WHY: He literally cannot write code himself — too slow, too boring. AI agents do the work during the gap. His attention fills the gaps between tasks, not during tasks.

IMPLICATION: His '536k lines in 5 months' came from orchestrating this cycle hundreds of times, not from sustained deep work. This is his natural operating mode, not a workaround.

ALSO: Can't verify/test agent output easily — the gap between prompting and reviewing is fine, but the manual testing step breaks the flow. Key blocker for his Pixel Office / automation ideas.

CONTEXT: He recognized this himself when describing why he can't 'do agents for hours at a time' — he's doing many short cycles, not one long session.
